title: Cultural Impact Assessment Framework
descriptions: Content: Conceptual and operational framework for assessing cultural impacts Purpose: To provide a structured, context-sensitive tool for evaluating the impacts of creative ex-urbanites Nature: Conceptual and policy-oriented framework Scope: Organised around socio-spatial, socio-ecological, and social dimensions Relation to other files: Builds on Creative Ex-Urban Typologies and Systematic Literature Reviews Serves as the main output of WP3 and informs WP4.
